metadata.title: This Little-Known Chip Stock Has Doubled. Wall Street Is Getting Bullish.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
This Little-Known Chip Stock Has Doubled. Wall Street Is Getting Bullish.
Shares of MACOM rose 4.7% and have surged 117% over the last year. The broader iShares Semiconductor ETF added 1%, while Broadcom advanced 2.2% and NXP Semiconductors N.V. fell 0.9%.
